scope: Independent source-only safety review of the existing-checkpoint, lookup-none recovery branch and Save geometry probe. No browser or test run.

A_runtime.reason: The new read-only diagnostic branch has not been run in this review lane. Run 002 only establishes the earlier recovery lookup-none stop before this branch existed.

findings: With an existing checkpoint, the runner validates it and reads the exact approved-organization recognition result. On result none it captures the same public fixture, waits for the real Scrape UI Save control, samples geometry, then deliberately fails into diagnostic_only. This branch never calls reserveSaveAttempt, recordObservedSourceId, or the Save click; it sends no keyboard input or DOM click. The existing checkpoint is opened read-only and is not rewritten or removed.

The capture action is the existing local page-capture path; the saving hook's network writes are only reached by its separate Save handler, which this recovery-none branch does not invoke. The recognition observer performs GET/event reads and response-body parsing only.

Diagnostic output is limited to counts, booleans, and nulls for active-pane state, target ownership, disabled state, area, clipping, hit testing, and clipping ancestor count. It emits no page text, organization name or ID, Source ID, URL, credentials, or response body.

The diagnostic measures one post-scroll geometry snapshot and does not claim stable-pointer acceptance. If the unique visible Save button is outside the linked active Scrape pane, it records ownership false rather than claiming a valid target.
limits: This is source safety approval for a read-only probe only; it does not prove runtime geometry or establish why the earlier Save attempt was ambiguous.
Existing unrelated SEO worktree changes were left untouched.

checks: No browser, tests, build, or network writes performed in this review.
